run_dump_qualifications: run the script to dump all MTurk qualifications from the Mephisto database to a JSON file
run_dump_specific_qualifications: run the script to dump specific named qualifications by providing a comma separated list
review_dump_qualifications: review the dump_qualifications function that exports qualification data with worker mappings to JSON
refactor_dump_qualifications: refactor dump_qualifications to accept CLI arguments instead of interactive input prompts
summarize_dump_qualifications: summarize the dump_qualifications function that filters sandbox entries and exports worker qualification data
